text: This report responds to City Council’s direction from November 2025 ( 2025.IE25.4 ) for the General Manager, Toronto Water, in consultation with the General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services, Director, Revenue Services, the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and the Chief Technology Officer, to retain a billing systems industry expert to assist in: a. gathering requirements, analyzing options and preparing a recommendation for a modern utility billing system; b. establishing a governance framework to ensure alignment of needs and responsibilities; c. developing a detailed implementation and procurement strategy in alignment with the work underway as part of recommendation 1 (align billing system Advanced Metering Infrastructure implementation strategies); and d. reporting back to Infrastructure and Environment Committee by the second quarter 2026 the resulting recommendation…

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Received the report (June 30, 2026) from the General Manager, Toronto Water, General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services, and the Director, Revenue Services for information.
